name: shipyard
description: Run the repo's /ship skill in background terminals (agterm sessions, or tmux) and supervise a fleet of them: one git worktree each, a status table every 10 minutes, and every question or architectural decision escalated back to the session you are sitting in. Requires a /ship skill in the repo — it launches nothing else.

interface.shortDescription: Supervise a fleet of background ship sessions
interface.longDescription: A shipyard is where many ships are built at once. Launches the repo's own /ship skill in one background terminal and git worktree per change, posts a markdown status table on a timer, watches for children that have stalled or run out of context, and carries every question and architectural decision from a child — which has no human in it — back to the session you are sitting in. Requires a /ship skill in the repo.
defaultPrompt: Show me the status of the running ship sessions
